invention.ref: Henry R. Heyl files US 195,603: first machine to insert and clinch a staple in one step
invention.ref_zh: 黑尔申请 US 195,603：首台一步完成穿钉与弯脚的机器

patent.ref: George McGill's Single-Stroke Staple Press, US 212,316 (18 Feb 1879)

mass_production.ref: McGill Single-Stroke Staple Press, first commercially successful stapler
mass_production.ref_zh: 麦吉尔单击订书机成为首款商业成功的订书机

notes: 谁发明了订书机说法不一：麦吉尔 1866 年先获得弯脚纸钉专利 US 56,587，但一步订装的机器由黑尔 1877 年申请；本条目以黑尔为发明、麦吉尔 1879 年为商业化。两人的具体城市未经核实，地点只标到国家。
summary_zh: 1877 年黑尔的机器首次一步完成穿钉与弯脚；1879 年麦吉尔的单击订书机成为第一款商业成功的订书机。
summary_en: Henry Heyl's 1877 machine first inserted and clinched a staple in one step; George McGill's 1879 Single-Stroke Staple Press was the first commercial success.

image.alt_zh: 一台白色桌面订书机和一排订书钉
image.alt_en: A white desktop stapler with a strip of staples

notes_en: Credit is split: McGill patented a bendable paper fastener in 1866 (US 56,587), but Heyl filed the first one-step stapling machine in 1877. This entry treats Heyl as inventor and McGill's 1879 press as the commercial breakthrough. Their cities are unverified, so locations are country-level.
